# And Then Some Music

> Chicago groove-first instrumental band led by guitarist Erik Oldman and drummer/percussionist Paul Abella, with saxophonist Randy Bufanda. Their repertoire draws on James Brown, Funkadelic, Herbie Hancock, Stax/Volt, Eddie Harris and Grant Green, plus heavy reinterpretations of Black Sabbath and Fugazi. Currently hosting a Jazz Centennial Monthly Residency.
